name: Mau-Mau
blurb: The German card game, for two to five. A seven makes the next player draw two and a seven answers a seven, an eight skips, a nine turns the play around and a jack asks for a suit - but never onto another jack. Down to one card, say Mau, and if you forget, anybody may catch you for two. Not a level: this document names a game the host runs, and the deck is held somewhere no player can reach.
